resources.string: Checks unfamiliar pages on your phone before you open them.
Reads the Chrome address bar so RedFlag can check unfamiliar sites before you interact with them. Page contents are analyzed on this device.
Opening the page in a sealed sandbox
Reading the page with on-device Gemma
The page opens without a verdict. Don\'t enter anything you\'re unsure about.
Nothing you see here leaves your phone.
I understand the risk, open it

Recommended. Runs only if you tap it: our cloud agent (Anthropic Claude) opens the page in an isolated browser and double-checks it. A situation you described or a message you pasted goes along, with numbers hidden.
We couldn\'t check this page in time
The page took too long to analyze. If you didn\'t expect this link, don\'t enter anything.
Ask the cloud for a second opinion
This site showed our cloud browser a different page than it showed you.
On your phone: %1$s · In the cloud: %2$s
Set RedFlag as the default browser. Safe links go straight to Chrome.
Let RedFlag read Chrome\'s address bar and cover unfamiliar pages until they\'re checked.

Pages are read by Gemma on this phone; the page itself never leaves it. Only the site\'s domain name is looked up in public registries. Only when you ask for advanced analysis does the link go to the cloud, together with any situation you described or message you pasted (numbers hidden). Never automatically, not even when it is recommended, and chats read from notifications are never sent.
Nothing leaves your phone. Advanced analysis is turned off.
Model file not found. Push it to %1$s
No checks yet. Tap a link in any app.
Advisory provided by Google. Google works to provide the most accurate and up-to-date information about unsafe web resources, but cannot guarantee it is comprehensive or error-free.
You came back to a site RedFlag already blocked
Lets RedFlag look at the message that carried a risky link, only when you allow it for that link. Kept in memory, never sent.
Ask how you got a link when it matters (payments, app installs, refunds). Every step can be skipped.
On-device first. Advanced (cloud) analysis runs only when you tap it, even when RedFlag recommends it; then a situation you described or a message you pasted goes along (numbers hidden).
Paste a link or the message you got
No link found. Check the address.
e.g. A seller in a used-goods trade sent a \"safe payment\" link
Checked before it is opened. A pasted message is used as context.
Make sure the text has an address starting with http or a domain like example.com.
This is the official domain of %1$s (%2$s).
Posts or messages hosted on a well-known site can still be scams.
Other links in the same message
Check a link before opening it
Sent along: %1$d situation note(s) · %2$d pasted message(s) (numbers hidden)
Starts once you answer or skip the question
Sites already checked are analysed again: no 12-hour safe cache, no replay of a stored block.
The site is down or the address does not exist. While it does not open there is nothing to type into. If a message sent you this link, do not open it again.
The site kept the check out
This site does not let security scanners in, so RedFlag could not see the page. If you do not know the site, do not enter anything.
While Chrome opens an unfamiliar site, cover the whole screen (the old behaviour). Off: a small pill at the top, full screen only when there is danger.
RedFlag check status. Tap for details
Typing is paused until the check is done
This site is not verified safe yet. Check before you enter a password
Paste a link or a message you got
Paste a link or a message you received. I check it on this phone before you open it.
After a check, tell me how you got it without a link (e.g. "a number I don\'t know texted me") and I will take it into account.
%d steps left to protect links automatically when you tap them.
I could not find a link. Paste a link, or the message that has one.
Advanced analysis did not finish. The on-device verdict stands.
I will take your situation into account once the verdict is in.
Taken into account. The verdict stays: %1$s %2$d
Your situation could not be applied to this check.
